_README: EXAMPLE / TEMPLATE profiles for OGFinder 'AI Services'. Copy to ~/.ds9/ai_services.json and edit. JSON has no comments, so keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. NOTHING here is a verified endpoint: every URL uses the reserved host example.invalid and cannot work until you replace it with a service you have access to and whose API you have read. Secrets are NEVER stored here: 'auth.env' is only the NAME of an environment variable.

services.name: simbad_cone
services._note: REAL public IVOA TAP service (non-ML example). Cone search by object position in SIMBAD. Needs RA/Dec columns and --allow-network. Verified live on the date given in docs/ai_services.md.
services.description: SIMBAD TAP: nearest object within a radius of each catalogue position (non-ML example)

request.adql: SELECT TOP 1 main_id, otype, ra, dec, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', {ra}, {dec})) * 3600.0 AS sep_arcsec FROM basic WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', {ra}, {dec}, {radius_deg})) ORDER BY sep_arcsec ASC
